prompt: Generate one production game UI background texture for Heroes of Orvesk, a painterly dark gothic fantasy RPG. Wide landscape panorama, ideally 3072x1024 pixels, 3:1. Entire canvas filled edge-to-edge with aged dark bronze-black leather-like patinated metal, muted olive charcoal and restrained brown-gold fine grain. Fine natural isotropic texture: tiny pores, soft irregular mottling, faint scratches, no stretched horizontal streaks or obvious repeating patterns. Low contrast, dark and calm enough for cream colored header text. Soft even diffuse light, no focal object, no border, no frame, no text, no icons, no gradient to transparency, fully opaque. This is a large continuous material sheet; any narrow horizontal crop from its center should work as a modal header. Preserve fine believable scale and rich hand-painted material detail rather than large cloudy streaks. The image will be shown at native aspect ratio and cropped, never squashed.
